#### **TS Analysis Data Prep**

```{r}

# 1. Sort by date
dta <- dta[order(dta$Date), ]

# 2. Extract numeric data as a matrix
data_matrix <- as.matrix(dta[, c("frp_avg_support", "asl_stand", "stock_rate_stand", "unemp_stand", "frp_gov_growing_acc", "parliamentary_elec", "utoya", "EU_referendum", "asylum_crisis_15", "asylum_crisis_93")])

# 3. Get start year and start month from first date
start_year <- as.numeric(format(min(dta$Date), "%Y"))
start_month <- as.numeric(format(min(dta$Date), "%m"))

# 4. Convert to ts object
ts_data <- ts(data_matrix, start = c(start_year, start_month), frequency = 12)
```

```{r}
summary(jotest)
```

#### **Initial Regression Models**

```{r}

#M1 No Interactions nor Accountability

M1 <- dynlm(frp_avg_support ~ L(frp_avg_support, 1) + L(frp_avg_support, 2) + asl_stand +
               L(asl_stand, 1) + L(asl_stand, 2) +
              stock_rate_stand + L(stock_rate_stand, 1) + L(stock_rate_stand, 2) +
              unemp_stand + L(unemp_stand, 1) + L(unemp_stand, 2) + parliamentary_elec +
              EU_referendum + utoya + asylum_crisis_15 + asylum_crisis_93, data = ts_data)

summary(M1)

#M2 Asylum Interaction and Accountability

M2 <- dynlm(frp_avg_support ~ L(frp_avg_support, 1) + L(frp_avg_support, 2) + asl_stand +
               L(asl_stand, 1) + L(asl_stand, 2) +
               stock_rate_stand + L(stock_rate_stand, 1) + L(stock_rate_stand, 2) +
               unemp_stand + L(unemp_stand, 1) + L(unemp_stand, 2) + parliamentary_elec +
               EU_referendum + utoya + asylum_crisis_15 + asylum_crisis_93 +
               frp_gov_growing_acc + 
               frp_gov_growing_acc:asl_stand + 
               frp_gov_growing_acc:L(asl_stand, 1) + 
               frp_gov_growing_acc:L(asl_stand, 2),
             data = ts_data)

summary(M2)

#M3 Stock Rate Interaction and Accountability

M3 <- dynlm(frp_avg_support ~ L(frp_avg_support, 1) + L(frp_avg_support, 2) + 
               asl_stand + L(asl_stand, 1) + L(asl_stand, 2) + 
               stock_rate_stand + L(stock_rate_stand, 1) + L(stock_rate_stand, 2) + 
               unemp_stand + L(unemp_stand, 1) + L(unemp_stand, 2) + 
               parliamentary_elec + EU_referendum + utoya + asylum_crisis_15 + asylum_crisis_93 + 
               frp_gov_growing_acc + 
               frp_gov_growing_acc:stock_rate_stand + 
               frp_gov_growing_acc:L(stock_rate_stand, 1) + 
               frp_gov_growing_acc:L(stock_rate_stand, 2),
             data = ts_data)

summary(M3)

#M4 Unemployment Interaction and Accountability

M4 <- dynlm(frp_avg_support ~ L(frp_avg_support, 1) + L(frp_avg_support, 2) + 
               asl_stand + L(asl_stand, 1) + L(asl_stand, 2) + 
               stock_rate_stand + L(stock_rate_stand, 1) + L(stock_rate_stand, 2) + 
               unemp_stand + L(unemp_stand, 1) + L(unemp_stand, 2) + 
               parliamentary_elec + EU_referendum + utoya + asylum_crisis_15 + asylum_crisis_93 + 
               frp_gov_growing_acc + 
               frp_gov_growing_acc:unemp_stand + 
               frp_gov_growing_acc:L(unemp_stand, 1) + 
               frp_gov_growing_acc:L(unemp_stand, 2),
             data = ts_data)

summary(M4)
```

#### **Assumptions Testing**

##### Lag Length

```{r}
#Lag Length Selection



# Define the range of lags you want to test
lag_range <- 1:12  # for example, lag from 1 to 10

# Create an empty data frame to store results
lag_results <- data.frame(Lag = integer(), AIC = numeric(), BIC = numeric())

# Loop through different lag lengths and fit models
for (lag in lag_range) {
  # Dynamically create the formula for each lag length
  model_formula <- as.formula(paste("frp_avg_support ~", 
                                    paste(paste("L(frp_avg_support,", 1:lag, ")", collapse = " + "), "+", 
                                          "asl_stand +", paste(paste("L(asl_stand,", 1:lag, ")", collapse = " + "), collapse = " + "), "+", 
                                          "stock_rate_stand +", paste(paste("L(stock_rate_stand,", 1:lag, ")", collapse = " + "), collapse = " + "), "+",
                                          "unemp_stand +", paste(paste("L(unemp_stand,", 1:lag, ")", collapse = " + "), collapse = " + "), "+",
                                          "parliamentary_elec + EU_referendum + utoya + asylum_crisis_15 + asylum_crisis_93")))
  
  # Fit the model using dynlm
  model <- dynlm(model_formula, data = ts_data)
  
  # Store the AIC and BIC for the model without creating additional objects
  lag_results <- rbind(lag_results, data.frame(Lag = lag, AIC = AIC(model), BIC = BIC(model)))
}

lag_results$AIC_BIC <- lag_results$AIC + lag_results$BIC

min(lag_results$AIC_BIC)

#Best lag length is 2


```

##### Autocorrelation

```{r}
#Testing for Autocorrleation 

# Perform Ljung-Box and Breusch-Godfrey tests for all models

# Create a function to perform both tests and return results in a structured format
test_models_to_table <- function(model) {
  # Extract residuals
  residuals_model <- residuals(model)
  
  # Ljung-Box test
  ljung_box_result <- Box.test(residuals_model, lag = 12, type = "Ljung-Box")
  
  # Breusch-Godfrey test
  bg_test_result <- bgtest(model, order = 12)
  
  # Return results in a list
  c(Ljung_Box_p_value = ljung_box_result$p.value, 
    BG_p_value = bg_test_result$p.value)
}

# Apply the function to all four models
results_M1 <- test_models_to_table(M1)
results_M2 <- test_models_to_table(M2)
results_M3 <- test_models_to_table(M3)
results_M4 <- test_models_to_table(M4)

# Combine results into a single data frame for easy comparison
test_results_df <- data.frame(
  Model = c("M1", "M2", "M3", "M4"),
  Ljung_Box_p_value = c(results_M1["Ljung_Box_p_value"], 
                        results_M2["Ljung_Box_p_value"], 
                        results_M3["Ljung_Box_p_value"], 
                        results_M4["Ljung_Box_p_value"]),
  BG_p_value = c(results_M1["BG_p_value"], 
                 results_M2["BG_p_value"], 
                 results_M3["BG_p_value"], 
                 results_M4["BG_p_value"])
)

# Print the results table
print(test_results_df)

#Conclusion: all p-values >0.05, no significant autocorrelation

```

##### Heteroskedasticity

```{r}
#Testing for Heteroskedasticity

# Applying White's test for heteroscedasticity
white_M1 <- white(M1)
white_M2 <- white(M2)
white_M3 <- white(M3)
white_M4 <- white(M4)

# Extracting the test statistics and p-values from the results
white_results <- data.frame(
  Model = c("M1", "M2", "M3", "M4"),
  White_Statistic = c(white_M1$statistic, white_M2$statistic, white_M3$statistic, white_M4$statistic),
  White_p_value = c(white_M1$p.value, white_M2$p.value, white_M3$p.value, white_M4$p.value)
)

# Display results
print(white_results)

```

```{r}
)

# View the results

# Plot histograms and Q-Q plots for the residuals of M1 to M4

# Define a plotting function for residuals
plot_residuals <- function(model, model_name) {
  residuals_data <- residuals(model)
  
  # Set up a 1x2 grid of plots (Histogram and Q-Q Plot)
  par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
  
  # Histogram of residuals
  hist(residuals_data, main = paste("Histogram of Residuals -", model_name),
       xlab = "Residuals", col = "lightblue", border = "black", breaks = 20)
  
  # Q-Q plot of residuals
  qqnorm(residuals_data, main = paste("Q-Q Plot -", model_name))
  qqline(residuals_data, col = "red")
}

# Apply the function to each model (M1 to M4)
plot_residuals(M1, "M1")
plot_residuals(M2, "M2")
plot_residuals(M3, "M3")
plot_residuals(M4, "M4")

# Reset the plotting layout to a single panel for other plots
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

Residuals and Influential Outliers

```{r}
# Remove first two rows from ts_data for matching with residuals
ts_data_adjusted <- ts_data[-(1:2), ]



# Augment the models with adjusted dataset
# Extract corresponding dates
adjusted_dates <- dta$Date[-(1:2)]

# For M1
ts_data_M1 <- augment(M1, data = ts_data_adjusted, na.action = na.pass) |>
  mutate(index = 1:n(),
         Date = adjusted_dates)

# For M2
ts_data_M2 <- augment(M2, data = ts_data_adjusted, na.action = na.pass) |>
  mutate(index = 1:n(),
         Date = adjusted_dates)

# For M3
ts_data_M3 <- augment(M3, data = ts_data_adjusted, na.action = na.pass) |>
  mutate(index = 1:n(),
         Date = adjusted_dates)

# For M4
ts_data_M4 <- augment(M4, data = ts_data_adjusted, na.action = na.pass) |>
  mutate(index = 1:n(),
         Date = adjusted_dates)


# Add standardized residuals categories (SRE) to the datasets

#For M1

ts_data_M1 <- ts_data_M1 |> 
  dplyr::mutate(SRE1.96 = dplyr::case_when(
    .std.resid > 1.96 | .std.resid < -1.96  ~ 1,
    .std.resid > -1.96 & .std.resid < 1.96 ~ 0
  ),
  SRE2.58 = dplyr::case_when(
    .std.resid > 2.58 | .std.resid < -2.58  ~ 1,
    .std.resid > -2.58 & .std.resid < 2.58 ~ 0
  ),
  SRE3.29 = dplyr::case_when(
    .std.resid > 3.29 | .std.resid < -3.29  ~ 1,
    .std.resid > -3.29 & .std.resid < 3.29 ~ 0
  ))

# For M2
ts_data_M2 <- ts_data_M2 |>
  mutate(SRE1.96 = case_when(
    .std.resid > 1.96 | .std.resid < -1.96  ~ 1,
    .std.resid > -1.96 & .std.resid < 1.96 ~ 0
  ),
  SRE2.58 = case_when(
    .std.resid > 2.58 | .std.resid < -2.58  ~ 1,
    .std.resid > -2.58 & .std.resid < 2.58 ~ 0
  ),
  SRE3.29 = case_when(
    .std.resid > 3.29 | .std.resid < -3.29  ~ 1,
    .std.resid > -3.29 & .std.resid < 3.29 ~ 0
  ))

# For M3
ts_data_M3 <- ts_data_M3 |>
  mutate(SRE1.96 = case_when(
    .std.resid > 1.96 | .std.resid < -1.96  ~ 1,
    .std.resid > -1.96 & .std.resid < 1.96 ~ 0
  ),
  SRE2.58 = case_when(
    .std.resid > 2.58 | .std.resid < -2.58  ~ 1,
    .std.resid > -2.58 & .std.resid < 2.58 ~ 0
  ),
  SRE3.29 = case_when(
    .std.resid > 3.29 | .std.resid < -3.29  ~ 1,
    .std.resid > -3.29 & .std.resid < 3.29 ~ 0
  ))

# For M4
ts_data_M4 <- ts_data_M4 |>
  mutate(SRE1.96 = case_when(
    .std.resid > 1.96 | .std.resid < -1.96  ~ 1,
    .std.resid > -1.96 & .std.resid < 1.96 ~ 0
  ),
  SRE2.58 = case_when(
    .std.resid > 2.58 | .std.resid < -2.58  ~ 1,
    .std.resid > -2.58 & .std.resid < 2.58 ~ 0
  ),
  SRE3.29 = case_when(
    .std.resid > 3.29 | .std.resid < -3.29  ~ 1,
    .std.resid > -3.29 & .std.resid < 3.29 ~ 0
  ))

# Check frequency distribution for SRE1.96, SRE2.58, and SRE3.29 for M1, M2, M3, and M4

expss::fre(ts_data_M1$SRE1.96)
expss::fre(ts_data_M1$SRE2.58)
expss::fre(ts_data_M1$SRE3.29)

expss::fre(ts_data_M2$SRE1.96)
expss::fre(ts_data_M2$SRE2.58)
expss::fre(ts_data_M2$SRE3.29)

expss::fre(ts_data_M3$SRE1.96)
expss::fre(ts_data_M3$SRE2.58)
expss::fre(ts_data_M3$SRE3.29)

expss::fre(ts_data_M4$SRE1.96)
expss::fre(ts_data_M4$SRE2.58)
expss::fre(ts_data_M4$SRE3.29)
```

### Piecewise Models

```{r}
#estimating piecewise model 1

# Split the data at observation 126
ts_data_pre_m1 <- window(ts_data, end = time(ts_data)[174])
ts_data_post_m1 <- window(ts_data, start = time(ts_data)[174])

# Estimate the same model for both segments
M1_pre <- dynlm(frp_avg_support ~ L(frp_avg_support, 1) + L(frp_avg_support, 2) + asl_stand +
                 L(asl_stand, 1) + L(asl_stand, 2) +
                 stock_rate_stand + L(stock_rate_stand, 1) + L(stock_rate_stand, 2) +
                 unemp_stand + L(unemp_stand, 1) + L(unemp_stand, 2) + parliamentary_elec +
                 EU_referendum + asylum_crisis_93 ,
               data = ts_data_pre_m1)

M1_post <- dynlm(frp_avg_support ~ L(frp_avg_support, 1) + L(frp_avg_support, 2) + asl_stand +
                 L(asl_stand, 1) + L(asl_stand, 2) +
                 stock_rate_stand + L(stock_rate_stand, 1) + L(stock_rate_stand, 2) +
                 unemp_stand + L(unemp_stand, 1) + L(unemp_stand, 2) + parliamentary_elec +
                 EU_referendum + utoya + asylum_crisis_15,
               data = ts_data_post_m1)

# View summaries
summary(M1_pre)
summary(M1_post)

#Model comparisons
stargazer(M1, M1_pre, M1_post,
          type = "text",
          title = "Comparison of Full Sample and Piecewise Models",
          column.labels = c("Full Sample", "Pre-Break (≤174)", "Post-Break (174+)"),
          keep.stat = c("n", "rsq", "adj.rsq"),
          no.space = TRUE,
          digits = 3)
```

##### Autocorrelation

```{r}

# Ljung-Box and Breusch-Godfrey Tests for M1_pre
ljung_box_M1_pre <- Box.test(residuals(M1_pre), lag = 12, type = "Ljung-Box")
bg_test_M1_pre <- bgtest(M1_pre, order = 12)

# Ljung-Box and Breusch-Godfrey Tests for M1_post
ljung_box_M1_post <- Box.test(residuals(M1_post), lag = 12, type = "Ljung-Box")
bg_test_M1_post <- bgtest(M1_post, order = 12)


# Ljung-Box and Breusch-Godfrey Tests for M2_pre
ljung_box_M2_pre <- Box.test(residuals(M2_pre), lag = 12, type = "Ljung-Box")
bg_test_M2_pre <- bgtest(M2_pre, order = 12)

# Ljung-Box and Breusch-Godfrey Tests for M2_post
ljung_box_M2_post <- Box.test(residuals(M2_post), lag = 12, type = "Ljung-Box")
bg_test_M2_post <- bgtest(M2_post, order = 12)

# Ljung-Box and Breusch-Godfrey Tests for M3_pre
ljung_box_M3_pre <- Box.test(residuals(M3_pre), lag = 12, type = "Ljung-Box")
bg_test_M3_pre <- bgtest(M3_pre, order = 12)

# Ljung-Box and Breusch-Godfrey Tests for M3_post
ljung_box_M3_post <- Box.test(residuals(M3_post), lag = 12, type = "Ljung-Box")
bg_test_M3_post <- bgtest(M3_post, order = 12)

# Ljung-Box and Breusch-Godfrey Tests for M4_pre
ljung_box_M4_pre <- Box.test(residuals(M4_pre), lag = 12, type = "Ljung-Box")
bg_test_M4_pre <- bgtest(M4_pre, order = 12)

# Ljung-Box and Breusch-Godfrey Tests for M4_post
ljung_box_M4_post <- Box.test(residuals(M4_post), lag = 12, type = "Ljung-Box")
bg_test_M4_post <- bgtest(M4_post, order = 12)

# Compile results into a data frame
results_piecewise_df <- data.frame(
  Model = c("M1_pre", "M1_post", "M2_pre", "M2_post", "M3_pre", "M3_post", "M4_pre", "M4_post"),
  Ljung_Box_p_value = c(ljung_box_M1_pre$p.value, ljung_box_M1_post$p.value, ljung_box_M2_pre$p.value, ljung_box_M2_post$p.value,
                        ljung_box_M3_pre$p.value, ljung_box_M3_post$p.value, ljung_box_M4_pre$p.value, ljung_box_M4_post$p.value),
  BG_p_value = c(bg_test_M1_pre$p.value, bg_test_M1_post$p.value, bg_test_M2_pre$p.value, bg_test_M2_post$p.value,
                 bg_test_M3_pre$p.value, bg_test_M3_post$p.value, bg_test_M4_pre$p.value, bg_test_M4_post$p.value)
)

# Print the table
print(results_piecewise_df)



```

##### Heteroskedasticity

```{r}
# Applying White's test for heteroscedasticity to split subsample models
white_M1_pre <- white(M1_pre)
white_M1_post <- white(M1_post)
white_M2_pre <- white(M2_pre)
white_M2_post <- white(M2_post)
white_M3_pre <- white(M3_pre)
white_M3_post <- white(M3_post)
white_M4_pre <- white(M4_pre)
white_M4_post <- white(M4_post)

# Extracting the test statistics and p-values from the results
white_results_split <- data.frame(
  Model = c("M1_pre", "M1_post", "M2_pre", "M2_post", "M3_pre", "M3_post", "M4_pre", "M4_post"),
  White_Statistic = c(white_M1_pre$statistic, white_M1_post$statistic, white_M2_pre$statistic, white_M2_post$statistic,
                      white_M3_pre$statistic, white_M3_post$statistic, white_M4_pre$statistic, white_M4_post$statistic),
  White_p_value = c(white_M1_pre$p.value, white_M1_post$p.value, white_M2_pre$p.value, white_M2_post$p.value,
                    white_M3_pre$p.value, white_M3_post$p.value, white_M4_pre$p.value, white_M4_post$p.value)
)

# Display results
print(white_results_split)



```

##### Normality

```{r}
#Testing for Normality on Subsample Models

# Perform the Jarque-Bera test for normality on the residuals of each model
jb_results <- data.frame(
  Model = c("M1_pre", "M1_post", "M2_pre", "M2_post", "M3_pre", "M3_post", "M4_pre", "M4_post"),
  JB_Statistic = c(
    jarque.bera.test(residuals(M1_pre))$statistic, 
    jarque.bera.test(residuals(M1_post))$statistic, 
    jarque.bera.test(residuals(M2_pre))$statistic, 
    jarque.bera.test(residuals(M2_post))$statistic, 
    jarque.bera.test(residuals(M3_pre))$statistic, 
    jarque.bera.test(residuals(M3_post))$statistic, 
    jarque.bera.test(residuals(M4_pre))$statistic, 
    jarque.bera.test(residuals(M4_post))$statistic
  ),
  p_value = c(
    jarque.bera.test(residuals(M1_pre))$p.value, 
    jarque.bera.test(residuals(M1_post))$p.value, 
    jarque.bera.test(residuals(M2_pre))$p.value, 
    jarque.bera.test(residuals(M2_post))$p.value, 
    jarque.bera.test(residuals(M3_pre))$p.value, 
    jarque.bera.test(residuals(M3_post))$p.value, 
    jarque.bera.test(residuals(M4_pre))$p.value, 
    jarque.bera.test(residuals(M4_post))$p.value
  )
)

# Display the results
print(jb_results)

# Plot histograms and Q-Q plots for the residuals of M1 to M4 (both pre and post)
plot_residuals <- function(model, model_name) {
  residuals_data <- residuals(model)
  
  # Set up a 1x2 grid of plots (Histogram and Q-Q Plot)
  par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
  
  # Histogram of residuals
  hist(residuals_data, main = paste("Histogram of Residuals -", model_name),
       xlab = "Residuals", col = "lightblue", border = "black", breaks = 20)
  
  # Q-Q plot of residuals
  qqnorm(residuals_data, main = paste("Q-Q Plot -", model_name))
  qqline(residuals_data, col = "red")
}

# Apply the function to each model (M1_pre, M1_post, M2_pre, M2_post, M3_pre, M3_post, M4_pre, M4_post)
plot_residuals(M1_pre, "M1_pre")
plot_residuals(M1_post, "M1_post")
plot_residuals(M2_pre, "M2_pre")
plot_residuals(M2_post, "M2_post")
plot_residuals(M3_pre, "M3_pre")
plot_residuals(M3_post, "M3_post")
plot_residuals(M4_pre, "M4_pre")
plot_residuals(M4_post, "M4_post")

# Reset the plotting layout to a single panel for other plots
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

##### Robust SE (HAC)

```{r}
#M1

# Calculate HAC robust standard errors for both models
hac_se_pre_m1 <- vcovHAC(M1_pre)
hac_se_post_m1 <- vcovHAC(M1_post)

# Extract standard errors from the HAC covariance matrix
hac_se_pre_m1_vals <- sqrt(diag(hac_se_pre_m1))
hac_se_post_m1_vals <- sqrt(diag(hac_se_post_m1))

# Display models with HAC standard errors using stargazer
stargazer(M1, M1_pre, M1_post,
          type = "text",
          title = "Comparison of Full Sample and Piecewise Models with HAC Standard Errors",
          column.labels = c("Full Sample", "Pre-Break (≤174)", "Post-Break (174+)"),
          keep.stat = c("n", "rsq", "adj.rsq"),
          se = list(NULL, hac_se_pre_m1_vals, hac_se_post_m1_vals),  # No HAC for M1, HAC for M1_pre and M1_post
          no.space = TRUE,
          digits = 3)
```

##### Autocorrelation

```{r}
# Ljung-Box and Breusch-Godfrey Tests for M1_pre
ljung_box_M1_pre2 <- Box.test(residuals(M1_pre2), lag = 12, type = "Ljung-Box")
bg_test_M1_pre2 <- bgtest(M1_pre2, order = 12)

# Ljung-Box and Breusch-Godfrey Tests for M1_post
ljung_box_M1_mid <- Box.test(residuals(M1_mid), lag = 12, type = "Ljung-Box")
bg_test_M1_mid <- bgtest(M1_mid, order = 12)

# Ljung-Box and Breusch-Godfrey Tests for M1_post
ljung_box_M1_post <- Box.test(residuals(M1_post), lag = 12, type = "Ljung-Box")
bg_test_M1_post <- bgtest(M1_post, order = 12)

# Ljung-Box and Breusch-Godfrey Tests for M2_pre
ljung_box_M2_pre <- Box.test(residuals(M2_pre), lag = 12, type = "Ljung-Box")
bg_test_M2_pre <- bgtest(M2_pre, order = 12)

# Ljung-Box and Breusch-Godfrey Tests for M2_post
ljung_box_M2_post <- Box.test(residuals(M2_post), lag = 12, type = "Ljung-Box")
bg_test_M2_post <- bgtest(M2_post, order = 12)

# Ljung-Box and Breusch-Godfrey Tests for M3_pre
ljung_box_M3_pre <- Box.test(residuals(M3_pre), lag = 12, type = "Ljung-Box")
bg_test_M3_pre <- bgtest(M3_pre, order = 12)

# Ljung-Box and Breusch-Godfrey Tests for M3_pre
ljung_box_M3_mid <- Box.test(residuals(M3_mid), lag = 12, type = "Ljung-Box")
bg_test_M3_mid <- bgtest(M3_mid, order = 12)

# Ljung-Box and Breusch-Godfrey Tests for M3_post
ljung_box_M3_post2 <- Box.test(residuals(M3_post2), lag = 12, type = "Ljung-Box")
bg_test_M3_post2 <- bgtest(M3_post2, order = 12)

# Ljung-Box and Breusch-Godfrey Tests for M4_pre
ljung_box_M4_pre <- Box.test(residuals(M4_pre), lag = 12, type = "Ljung-Box")
bg_test_M4_pre <- bgtest(M4_pre, order = 12)

# Ljung-Box and Breusch-Godfrey Tests for M4_post
ljung_box_M4_mid <- Box.test(residuals(M4_mid), lag = 12, type = "Ljung-Box")
bg_test_M4_mid <- bgtest(M4_mid, order = 12)

# Ljung-Box and Breusch-Godfrey Tests for M4_post
ljung_box_M4_post2 <- Box.test(residuals(M4_post2), lag = 12, type = "Ljung-Box")
bg_test_M4_post2 <- bgtest(M4_post2, order = 12)

# Compile results into a data frame
results_piecewise_df_2 <- data.frame(
  Model = c("M1_pre2","M1_mid", "M1_post", "M2_pre", "M2_post", "M3_pre","M3_mid", "M3_post2", "M4_pre","M4_mid", "M4_post2"),
  Ljung_Box_p_value = c(ljung_box_M1_pre2$p.value, ljung_box_M1_mid$p.value, ljung_box_M1_post$p.value, ljung_box_M2_pre$p.value, ljung_box_M2_post$p.value,
                        ljung_box_M3_pre$p.value, ljung_box_M3_mid$p.value, ljung_box_M3_post2$p.value, ljung_box_M4_pre$p.value, ljung_box_M4_mid$p.value, ljung_box_M4_post2$p.value),
  BG_p_value = c(bg_test_M1_pre2$p.value, bg_test_M1_mid$p.value, bg_test_M1_post$p.value, bg_test_M2_pre$p.value, bg_test_M2_post$p.value,
                 bg_test_M3_pre$p.value, bg_test_M3_mid$p.value, bg_test_M3_post2$p.value, bg_test_M4_pre$p.value, bg_test_M4_mid$p.value, bg_test_M4_post2$p.value)
)

# Print the table
print(results_piecewise_df_2)

```

##### Normality

```{r}
# Define model names
models2 <- c("M1_pre2", "M1_mid", "M1_post", 
             "M2_pre", "M2_post", 
             "M3_pre", "M3_mid", "M3_post2", 
             "M4_pre", "M4_mid", "M4_post2")

# Jarque-Bera test for normality on each model's residuals
jb_results <- data.frame(
  Model = models2,
  JB_Statistic = sapply(models2, function(m) jarque.bera.test(residuals(get(m)))$statistic),
  p_value = sapply(models2, function(m) jarque.bera.test(residuals(get(m)))$p.value)
)

# Display the results
print(jb_results)

# Define function to plot histogram and Q-Q plot for residuals
plot_residuals <- function(model, model_name) {
  residuals_data <- residuals(model)
  
  # Set up 1x2 plotting layout
  par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
  
  # Histogram
  hist(residuals_data, main = paste("Histogram -", model_name),
       xlab = "Residuals", col = "lightblue", border = "black", breaks = 20)
  
  # Q-Q Plot
  qqnorm(residuals_data, main = paste("Q-Q Plot -", model_name))
  qqline(residuals_data, col = "red")
}

# Loop through all models and plot residual diagnostics
for (m in models2) {
  plot_residuals(get(m), m)
}

# Reset plotting layout
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

```

##### ?Robust SE

```{r}
#Models that fail Autocorrelation or Heterskedasiticty Tests:

# Calculate HAC robust standard errors for both models
hac_se_pre2_m1 <- vcovHAC(M1_pre2)
hac_se_pre_m3 <- vcovHAC(M3_pre)
hac_se_post2_m3 <- vcovHAC(M3_post2)
hac_se_pre_m4 <- vcovHAC(M4_pre)

# Extract standard errors from the HAC covariance matrix

hac_se_pre2_m1_vals <-  sqrt(diag(hac_se_pre2_m1))
hac_se_pre_m3_vals <-  sqrt(diag(hac_se_pre_m3))
hac_se_post2_m3_vals <-  sqrt(diag(hac_se_post2_m3))
hac_se_pre_m4_vals <-  sqrt(diag(hac_se_pre_m4))
```
